findings.description: Direct V23 sit view still exposes both fitted shorts and substantial upper thighs: the extended front apron falls behind the seated thighs instead of remaining across them. The crouch view covers more but shows the lap panels lifting off the bent legs. The bounded 80 mm extension and 25 mm projection did not resolve coverage.
V23 front, side and rear views still show irregular planar corrugation, pinched folds and a lumpy side/rear mass rather than controlled skirt pleats.
Direct back view still does not make the waist adjustment tab or buckle identifiable.
The V23 mesh showcase continues to record authored UV status MISSING; a topology illustration is not a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V23 adds a front-only skirt apron extension and projection. Direct inspection of all five views and six poses shows that the sit pose still exposes the fitted shorts and substantial upper thighs; crouch coverage improves only partially, while skirt faceting and unreadable rear hardware remain. Authored UVs are still absent.

nextAction: REJECT. Replace the skirt panel/attachment or deformation approach so the front layer remains over the thighs during sit and crouch; revise the cloth/fold construction to remove faceting; make the rear adjustment tab and buckle legible from the back; author and verify real UVs on the current garment source. Rebuild as a new revision and directly inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified or blocked.
